id: title:Gilbert09:ignore a stale schema probe after switching sources

review.posthog_relevance: Adds connector identity change detection and stale result prevention to warehouse connector provisioning, supporting warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.reason: Adds connectorSelectionCount state and checks connector identity changes before processing warehouse probe results, preventing stale data when connector identity changes mid-probe.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied hunks; no broader context or test results available.

observations.posthog_connection: Stores a count of connector selections, not the connector identity, to distinguish between selection and probe. This supports the next hunks' behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds connectorSelectionCount state and its reducer, incrementing on selectConnector.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses the selection count to detect if the connector identity has changed while a probe is pending, rather than relying on connector identity alone.

observations.behavior: Checks connectorChanged before processing schema results; returns early if connector identity changed.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents stale probe results from reaching the UI when the connector identity changes while a probe is pending.
